title: Annotatio V §.VI: Second grade — perfect Union = total Ecclesiastical Consociation
pass_a_gloss: the other is stretched out to perfect Union, and completes total Ecclesiastical Consociation.
pass_b_english: The other stretches out to perfect Union.
There it completes total ecclesiastical Consociation.
source_text: alter ad perfectam Unionem exporrigitur, totalemque consociationem Ecclesiasticam conficit.
